description: Every uncountable family of finite subsets of an arbitrary type contains an uncountable delta-system with a finite root.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DeltaSystems.uncountable_delta_system.{u} {α : Type u} {A : Set (Set α)} (hA : ¬A.Countable)
  (hfinite : ∀ a ∈ A, a.Finite) :
  ∃ B ⊆ A, ¬B.Countable ∧ ∃ r, r.Finite ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DeltaSystems.IsDeltaSystem B r
